name: Methow River (Carlton – Pateros)
blurb: Dry-side canyon float down to the Columbia — mellow above Averill, splashy Black Canyon below.

sections.notes: Unimproved river access at both ends; toilets. Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass required at both WDFW sites.

Black Canyon: Class III rapids with Black Canyon rapid (III+) at AW mile ~9.8. Bridge 1 Access (mile ~13) is an intermediate exit. Zahn's access is private. Discover Pass or WDFW Vehicle Access Pass at Averill (WDFW). Confirm the intended Pateros takeout and current access before planning this stretch.
sections.accessReview: Pateros takeout access remains unconfirmed. The City schedules a two-to-four-week Methow Boat Launch closure from October 19; reopening has not been confirmed. Verify the intended public takeout and current access before planning this stretch.

notices.title: Check Pateros launch closure
notices.text: The City’s construction notice schedules Methow Boat Launch to close for two to four weeks from October 19. Reopening has not been confirmed in this review. Check with the City before setting a shuttle; another city launch is not automatically a substitute for this river takeout.
notices.sourceName: City of Pateros — Methow Boat Launch construction

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
